g.title: cluster_state
g.text: from the chain at the origin, carried day to day

g.title: in:events
g.text: and stake choices of the year

g.title: block:renewal
g.text: RenewalLogit on tenure, after a return,
duration and stake; redrawn each run,

g.title: step
g.text: each commitment ending today renews on the
same node or leaves the set
each node out of the set for
up to 365 days may come back
each renewed, returned or new commitment
draws its duration, then its stake
the reward mechanism prices each commitment
open commitments that go on, then today's new
ones, then the scheduled ones due today

g.title: block:returns
g.text: Return: return after more than seven days
ReturnLogitHazard on days out, stake band,

g.title: block:durations
g.text: renewing or returning: the year's moves
with a like previous duration; new: the
year's first commitments; resampled each run

g.title: block:stake
g.text: Stake hurdle: stake of the next commitment
StakeChoice: keep the stake or change it,
by renewal, return or entry, stake

g.title: state:open
g.text: stake, days left, duration, tenure and record of each

g.title: state:out
g.text: up to 365 days; stake, days out, tenure and record of each

g.title: state:supply
g.text: supply_navax, which the reward formula reads

g.title: state:scheduled
g.text: accepted by the origin, start later;
fixed, add no issuance in the run

g.title: out:daily
g.text: Daily table, a row per run and day

g.title: in:ledger
g.text: supply, mean daily burn of the year
